Article Guidance
This article accompanies the local coverage determination for major joint
replacement of the knee and supplies the coding detail that determination refers
to. It does not establish coverage independently; the coverage criteria are stated
in the associated determination.

CPT/HCPCS Codes
Group 1 codes are reported for the covered procedure addressed by the associated
determination. Code values are listed without descriptor text.

Group 1: 27447

ICD-10-CM Codes that Support Medical Necessity
Group 1 diagnosis codes support medical necessity for the procedure listed above
when the clinical criteria in the associated determination are met.

Group 1: M17.11, M17.12

ICD-10-CM Codes that DO NOT Support Medical Necessity
Group 1: Z96.651

Revision History
R2 effective 2023-07-01. Aligned with revision R4 of the associated determination.
